basic_info.description: Perfectly perched on the 19th floor with sweeping views of the Bay, Residence 19B offers one of the most captivating water outlooks in all of South Beach, visible from every room. Upon entry, you're welcomed by an office nook & gourmet kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, & ample cabinetry for storage. The kitchen opens to a spacious dining & living area where the panoramic vistas amplify. Just off the living room, a deck showcases not only iconic views of the water, but Oracle Park, the Marina, & the rolling hills spanning five Bay Area counties. The home has a thoughtful split-bedroom layout for comfort & privacy. The serene guest bedroom enjoys tranquil outlooks & is just adjacent to the guest bathroom. On the opposite side, the primary suite is a true retreat, featuring two closets & a spa-like bathroom with dual vanities, a soaking tub, & a separate walk-in shower. Luxury amenities include a 24-hour front desk, outdoor pool & spa, & BBQ area. 19B also comes with one of the most convenient parking spaces in the building. Ideally located steps from the Embarcadero, South Beach Harbor, Oracle Park, restaurants, cafes, shopping, SF MUNI, BART, & easy freeway access, this is one of the most exciting & dynamic neighborhoods in The City.
